_doc: Members are [id, parentId, order]. Shapes: a leaf is its id, a Manager with Direct reports is [id, [shapes]]. Placements are {id, parentId, order}. 'dean' is 1 Dean > (2 CS head > 4, 3 IS head > 5), 6 Registrar.

buildOrgTree.name: sorts siblings by order then id
cycle is surfaced as a root
self parent is surfaced as a root

reparentOnDelete.name: reports move up into the deleted slot, keeping order
reports of a root become roots between the neighbouring roots
last root leaf needs no renumbering
